topics.description: Recent Congressional hearing with Governor Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison over alleged fraud in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program. Republicans grilled Walz and Ellison, questioning their knowledge of and response to the fraud.
Claims of whistleblower intimidation have surfaced during the investigation into Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program. This has raised concerns about the state's response to allegations of fraud.
topics.reason: New allegations of wrongdoing by state officials
